POWER AFRICA SOLAR IN THE COMMUNITY

Delivering Energy for Homes

Power Africa Solar is dedicated to powering our customer’s lives. We install clean, safe and reliable energy sources as we invest in building a healthier and more reliable resilient community. 

Supporting Rural Endeavours

We are committed to supporting local communities and their unique needs for electric infrastructure. In collaboration with independent community elders and leaders, We provide reliable energy access in the most sustainable way possible.

The company understands that each community has its own distinct challenges when it comes to providing electricity, so we are dedicated to working closely with these stakeholders in order to develop innovative solutions tailored specifically for each location’s individual requirements. Through this collaborative approach, Power Africa Solar hopes not only meet the vital need of electrification but also create long lasting positive impacts on the lives of those living within these communities.

More

Residential Install

Power Africa Solar works with our clients to ensure their energy needs are met to service their ever-expanding power demands.  Whether it’s a new house build, an existing house, or an apartment unit we are the experts that will take care of you.

We offer unmatched customer support before, during, and after the project. 

More

What Brands Do We Offer? Power Africa Solar offers a portfolio of energy storage and solar equipment.
